name: When is the best time to install trim and molding during a renovation?
description: Install trim and molding after drywall and painting, but before final flooring, for a clean finish.

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to install trim and molding during a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trim and molding are typically installed after major construction phases like drywall installation and painting, but before final flooring is laid. This sequence ensures a clean finish, preventing paint from getting on new floors and allowing for any necessary adjustments to trim pieces once walls are complete.
acceptedAnswer.description: Install trim and molding after drywall and painting, but before final flooring, for a clean finish.
